subject: Request: BCP/DR evidence & recent RTO/RPO traces for SIG/CAIQ review
messages:
From: Lauren Cheng <lauren.cheng@acmehealth.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Health Security Team <secops@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: BCP/DR evidence ask for upcoming SIG/CAIQ review

Hi Avery,

As part of our SIG/CAIQ mapping ahead of next month's review, we need the most recent BCP/DR materials from Redwood to validate recovery commitments against our vendor risk policy. Specifically could you provide: 

- The latest runbook that describes failover steps and escalation contacts (PDF preferred)
- RTO and RPO measurement logs from the last two recovery exercises (timestamped logs or CSV)
- Any runbook attestations or signed statements you can provide for SOC 2 evidence
- A short summary of warm-standby behavior and how KV cache / session state is handled during failover

We have a SIG review window on 2026-10-06 and would like artifacts by EOD 2026-09-24. If you prefer to share a zipped bundle or a Drive link that's fine. Also let us know if you need a specific format.

Thanks,
Lauren Cheng
Security Sr. Manager, Acme Health
lauren.cheng@acmehealth.com

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Cheng <lauren.cheng@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BCP/DR evidence ask for upcoming SIG/CAIQ review

Hi Lauren — thanks for the heads up. We can absolutely get a bundle together by 2026-09-24 EOD. Plan:

1) Aditya will pull the most recent runbook and attach the DR-runbook.pdf (operational steps + escalation contacts).
2) We will include a time-series CSV and raw log excerpt with measured RTO/RPO for the last two tabletop drills and the warm-standby exercise.
3) Marissa will prepare a short attestation language you can include in your SIG/CAIQ evidence packet; if you need a signed DocuSign we can submit that as well.

Quick notes for expectations: our most recent warm-standby test (2026-08-18) shows average RTO of ~00:00:05 for stateless API requests under normal load, and RPO of 0 for traffic routed through our edge caches. For stateful batch jobs the observed RPO window was <= 15 minutes. I don't want to pre-empt Aditya's formal numbers but wanted to set expectations.

Aditya / Marissa — can you confirm attachments and add any additional evidence (traces, runbook excerpt, signed statement)? Lauren — let us know if CSV format + zipped logs is preferred.

Thanks,
Avery Johnson
Product Security Programs, Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.ai
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>, Lauren Cheng <lauren.cheng@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BCP/DR evidence ask for upcoming SIG/CAIQ review

Attaching preliminary artifacts here (will upload zipped bundle to shared Drive by EOD 9/24):

Attachments referenced: DR-runbook.pdf, warm-standby-traces-2026-09.log

Key verification points (summary):
- RTO: measured 00:00:05 median for stateless inference endpoints (p95 under normal load ~00:00:08).
- RPO: 0 for persisted request/response state where writes commit synchronously; for long-running job checkpoints we observed <=15 minutes of potential data window.
- Recovery exercises included: 2026-04-12 (tabletop, failover dry-run), 2026-08-18 (warm-standby failover exercise), and 2026-09-10 (component restart stress tests). Logs include timestamps for failover start/end and KV cache warm-up metrics.

Notes on evidence: the log file warm-standby-traces-2026-09.log includes annotated markers for failover start (MARK_FAILOVER_START) and service-ready (MARK_SERVICE_READY). We can also generate a CSV with the exact timestamps if you prefer (start,end,duration,test-id).

Marissa — I left a draft attestation in the Drive under /evidence/Acme/attestation-draft.docx; please review and finalize.

Lauren — happy to provide DocuSign if you need a signed statement. If Acme has a specific attestation template, send it over and we'll sign.

- Aditya Rao
Head of Reliability, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
From: Lauren Cheng <lauren.cheng@acmehealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 08:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BCP/DR evidence ask for upcoming SIG/CAIQ review

Thanks Aditya — that level of detail is exactly what we need. Two small asks before your final bundle: 

1) Can you export a simple CSV with the timestamped start/end/duration rows for the 2026-08-18 and 2026-09-10 exercises? That will map directly into our control tests column.
2) We will need an attestation signed by an executive (DocuSign is preferred). I can share Acme's attestation template if helpful — otherwise your standard language will likely suffice.

Also, for the runbook redlines: our security reviewer may request minor clarifications on RTO owners and escalation SLAs. Can Marissa own that review?

If you can get the CSV + DocuSign-ready attestation by 9/24 EOD that will be ideal. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Lauren
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Cheng <lauren.cheng@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 24 Sep 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BCP/DR evidence ask for upcoming SIG/CAIQ review

Lauren — final bundle uploaded and links below. Per your asks we included:

- redwood_rto_rpo_2026-08-zip (CSV: rto_rpo_exercise_summary.csv with rows for 2026-08-18 and 2026-09-10)
- DR-runbook.pdf (runbook with marked escalation owners and SLAs)
- warm-standby-traces-2026-09.log (annotated log excerpts)
- attestation (DocuSign-ready PDF): DocuSign link included below

Drive bundle: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cDRdocs (Acme/Redwood/BCP-DR-2026-09-24)
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/companies/ACME-5678
DocuSign attestation: https://www.docusign.com/agreements/AS-2026-09-24-4521

Marissa has reviewed and tightened the escalation SLAs per your comment. If you need us to produce a versioned spreadsheet with additional columns (test-runner, verifier, environment) say the word and we'll add them.

Next steps: once you confirm receipt I'll trigger the DocuSign signature from our Legal lead (expected turnaround 48 hours).

Thanks,
Avery Johnson
Product Security Programs, Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.ai

Attachments in bundle: redwood_rto_rpo_2026-08.zip (contains rto_rpo_exercise_summary.csv), DR-runbook.pdf, warm-standby-traces-2026-09.log
